nora (auditor): Hi team — auditor request: we need a forensics-ready evidence bundle after an RBAC patch to infra/archive-sa that happened during a vuln triage. Suspected KMS decrypts triggered an alert. Timebox: 2026-02-28T21:30:00Z -> 2026-02-28T22:10:00Z. Want RBAC delta, KMS Decrypts, and any downstream data reads. Keep bundle minimal and include a one-line conclusion per event.

ethan: Acknowledged. Which RoleBinding name?

nora (auditor): RoleBinding: archive-access-binding. Edit recorded ~2026-02-28T21:47:12Z.

li-wei: Plan: extract kube-apiserver audit slice for RoleBinding updates, IRSA annotations to map k8s SA -> AWS role, CloudTrail Decrypt events for keys aliased alias/redwood-*, and S3 GetObject / app-read traces. We'll produce a signed manifest and redaction report.

jamal: Quick checklist: 1) kubectl audit slice 2) IRSA map 3) cloudtrail decrypts 4) siem correlation (x-amz-request-id -> request_id) 5) token issuance logs. Commands I'm running locally: 

# RBAC slice
kubectl --context=prod get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.name=="archive-access-binding" or .reason=="RoleBindingUpdated")' > k8s_rbac_archive.json

# IRSA map (annotations)
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns: .metadata.namespace, name: .metadata.name, annotations: .metadata.annotations}' > irsa_map.json

# CloudTrail Decrypts (timeboxed)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-02-28T21:30:00Z --end-time 2026-02-28T22:10:00Z --query 'Events[]' > cloudtrail_decrypts.json

# SIEM / S3 join (sample)
aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/02/28/21/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-02-28T21:30:00Z' AND '2026-02-28T22:10:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads_window.json

li-wei: Correlation tips: match CloudTrail requestParameters.keyId and userIdentity.arn to the IRSA-derived role ARN. Then join on request_id / x-amz-request-id to app traces. If token/session creation time < RBAC edit time then decrypt likely unrelated.

nora (auditor): Please include: manifest.txt (includes window, exported-by, git-sha of extraction scripts, checksums), k8s_rbac_archive.json, irsa_map.json, cloudtrail_decrypts.json, s3_reads_window.json, correlation_notes.md (one-line per decrypt), redaction_report.txt, extract_cmds.sh.

ethan: We'll hash object keys with sha256 placeholder and include redaction mapping in redaction_report.txt (no raw PII in the bundle). Also include exact CLI commands and the git commit id of the script used to export.

jamal: export-bot starting export job: evidence_1711379999_archive_20260228. Staging to s3://redwood-compliance-exports/. Presigned URL will be generated and valid 7 days.

export-bot: Job started. Gathering artifacts: kube-audit (slice), IRSA mapping, cloudtrail decrypt events, s3 reads, token-issue logs.

li-wei: I see three Decrypt events in cloudtrail_decrypts.json at 21:36:05Z, 21:46:58Z, 21:49:30Z. The RoleBinding edit is 21:47:12Z. So first two decrypts are pre-edit or just-before-edit; one decrypt at 21:49:30Z is post-edit. We'll validate session ARN for the post-edit event.

nora (auditor): If the post-edit decrypt's session was assumed before 21:47:12Z, mark as unrelated. If it's a new session after the edit and principal matches the modified SA/role, note "potentially related" and escalate.

ethan: We'll include STS AssumeRole/GetCallerIdentity events and the Kube token issuer logs to show token issuance time. I'll attach both into the bundle as token_issuer_logs.txt and sts_events.json.

jamal: export-bot: Packaging artifacts now. Creating manifest and computing sha256 checksums.

export-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/evidence_1711379999_archive_20260228.zip (presigned: https://presigned.example/ev/1711379999, valid 7 days). Manifest SHA256: b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfadea2a1c...

li-wei: correlation_notes.md will mark the 21:49:30Z decrypt as "ambiguous - session_arn: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-archive-role/session123; session_creation: 2026-02-28T21:46:55Z (pre-edit) -> unrelated". We'll include human-readable rationale per line.

nora (auditor): Perfect. I'll download and review. If anything looks anomalous I'll reopen the thread. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

ethan: Closing loop from our side. If auditor needs full forensic artifacts (raw object keys or full access logs) we'll raise a limited-scope forensic request and get approvals. :lock:
